elder_maelis.name: Elder Maelis
elder_maelis.description: The kindly matriarch of Gloamreach Village, Elder Maelis is a silver-haired elven woman with gentle eyes and centuries of wisdom. She welcomes travelers with tea, tales, and measured advice, but a deep sadness shadows her when the conversation turns to the curse on the land.

thornkin_rella.name: Thornkin Rella
thornkin_rella.description: A quick-witted, thorn-fingered half-fey merchant, Rella always has a mischievous smile and a knack for finding what others cannot. She’s famed for her rare reagents and her odd riddles.

spectral_child.name: Spectral Child
spectral_child.description: A ghostly apparition of a small child who wanders the stalls at dusk. The villagers are used to her silence, but sometimes she points at items as if remembering something important.

nimblethorn.name: Nimblethorn
nimblethorn.description: A sly, fey-influenced goblin with mottled green skin and a cap of fungus for a hat. Nimblethorn skips from shadow to shadow, offering cryptic warnings and bargains to those who show respect for the old ways. Deeply connected to the glade’s curse, Nimblethorn knows secret paths and hidden dangers.

whisperroot.name: Whisperroot
whisperroot.description: A spectral dryad, now half-fused with the stone’s roots. Whisperroot weeps for the land’s pain and offers cryptic warnings. Her influence can briefly purify an area if properly entreated.

lost_ranger_serik.name: Lost Ranger Serik
lost_ranger_serik.description: A grizzled, mud-streaked human ranger, Serik has lost his bearings after days evading dangerous creatures. He is wary but desperate for help and can offer detailed knowledge of the Blightfen Wilds for those who earn his trust.

thornwraith_myrlaen.name: Thornwraith Myrlaen
thornwraith_myrlaen.description: The corrupted druid responsible for the curse upon Wraithwood. Myrlaen appears as a spectral, root-entwined figure, their eyes glowing with malice and pain. They are torn between rage at intruders and an unconscious plea for release from their torment.

gravenbark_guardians.name: Gravenbark Guardians
gravenbark_guardians.description: Sentient, animated wooden statues bound to the crossroads by ancient druidic magic. They question travelers and pass judgment based on spoken intent.

shade_of_alenwen.name: Shade of Alenwen
shade_of_alenwen.description: A mournful spirit of a long-dead druidic guardian, bound to the hilltop. Alenwen seeks the restoration of the Wilds and offers cryptic guidance, but flies into a spectral rage if memories of betrayal are invoked.

surviving_druids.name: Surviving Druids
surviving_druids.description: A haggard trio of druids, their once-green robes now stained with bramble blood and their eyes haunted. They cling to the hope of reversing the Wilds’ corruption but are wary of strangers, suspecting betrayal or madness from any who survive here.

manifestation_of_the_forest_s_spirit.name: Manifestation of the Forest’s Spirit
manifestation_of_the_forest_s_spirit.description: A shimmering, wounded avatar of the ancient woods, appearing as a white stag entwined with blood-red roses and spectral vines. Its eyes plead for aid, but its form flickers with dangerous, uncontrolled power.
